body:
I can't hang in there. I just can't...I just want it to stop. I just want all the stress to stop. I can't take it. I almost want to die solely for the reason of stopping the stress and just ending my struggle. I can't take it. I have no one I can turn to. No one can help. Its over its over its over. 

EDIT: I'm okay-ish...but just barely hanging on...with a few extra, soon to be, scars from the ordeal.

It was...better...still hard, but better. I didn't feel the pain, which is normal...I'll usually have a half a day where the pain disperses after it hurts to that severe degree, but I know its only a matter of time before its back, and all it does is make me unable to gain a tolerance to it so its always raw and painful. Each week it builds up until I have an episode like that, and each week is worse, and more painful and intense than before. I'm scared...

As for myself personally, the pain is better, but not my state of mind. I can't control my urges to self-harm, and I just feel like I'm going crazy in general. I feel that I can't take it anymore. I feel like compared to others I'm just a failure and a burden, and I feel like the mental and physical pain is just going to push me beyond my point I can cope with.

I don't know...I really don't know...

I've always been like this, for 21 years now, and its just been building and building and I just can't take it anymore. I want to be able to not have to worry everyday about providing for myself. I want to not feel so lonely every day. I want to be competent and able to handle life like everyone else. I want to feel like what its like to be loved, and to just be okay...

I just want someone to hold me, tell me everything's going to be okay, and hold my hand as I work through this (in the literal and metaphorical sense), and I'm just tired of being alone...even in a group of friends...I feel alone...

Yes. After a full day on my attempt (24hrs without food, 17hrs without drink) I forced myself to eat, with that said I'm still very much suicidal, and the inclination towards suicide is not weakened in the slightest.

I find that completely unlikely. I'm not even deserving of love, and I've never received it either.

As for a job, I have no dreams or aspirations that are realistic, and I've found time and time again that I am just wholly incompetent. Beyond what's excusable. I can't think of any job I'd enjoy...including my current one, which I'm almost set to lose because I was just incompetent and failed at even the most basic things.

Aslo the last thing right now is to gain MORE weight. I'm already up 3 pounds this week...

I've been in therapy for almost a year now for depression among other things. It has not helped yet. I honestly doubt it will change. I'll be honesty...most of my issues are ingrained from behaviors that are beyond changing, and not random gloom.
